title: Equirectangular Still Sidecar Schema
description: Metadata generated alongside each 360° equirectangular still capture in raw_data/equirect_stills/still_XXXX.json

sequence.description: 1-based sequence index of the still in the capture session.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch time (UTC) when the still was triggered.

still_source.description: Camera model or capture source identifier (e.g., RICOH THETA X).

width.description: Pixel width of the equirectangular JPEG image.

height.description: Pixel height of the equirectangular JPEG image.

phone_transform.description: 4x4 column-major phone-to-world transform at the moment of capture.

cam_transform.description: 4x4 column-major 360° camera-to-world transform, composed from phone pose + baked rig profile at capture time.

camera_file_url.description: Source URI or path on the external camera device.

trigger_ms.description: Elapsed milliseconds to trigger the shutter.

transfer_ms.description: Elapsed milliseconds to download the image from the camera.

bytes.description: File size of the captured JPEG image in bytes.

rig_calibration_source.description: Source of the rig calibration used for cam_transform. Consumers should test for the 'solved' PREFIX rather than an exact match: anything starting with 'solved' carries a fitted rig extrinsic, anything else is the mechanical prior.

rig_calibration_residual_px_rms.description: RMS reprojection error of the calibration fit, in pixels of the 512-wide working equirect. NOT comparable across scans with different still counts: the RMS rises with the number of constraints, so a 5-input solve cannot be read against a 3-input one.

rig_calibration_solver_version.description: Version of the rig solver that produced cam_transform. A bump forces a re-solve on the scan's next Process, which is how superseded calibrations self-heal.

rig_calibration_railed.description: Solved parameters that came back sitting on a bound of their search box, one human-readable phrase each. NON-EMPTY MEANS THE POSE IS APPROXIMATE: the optimizer ran out of model rather than converging on the data, and the residual is a boundary value, not a fit. Empty array is the healthy case; the key is written on every bake, so its ABSENCE means the producing build predates this field, not that nothing was railed.

elevation_offset_deg.description: Uniform vertical registration offset between the equirect's rows and the latitude mapping, solved per scan (+ = image content sits lower than geometry predicts). Consumers sampling the equirect with the standard mapping should compensate by this much. This is a fitted nuisance parameter absorbing model error, not a measured camera property, and is expected to be retired.
